segments.text: Welcome back to the Sozzled Pod, it is good to be here with both of you.
This week we are talking about the ATEM Mini Pro and why the final mix keeps arriving late.
Chris, you said the posting slot changed everything for you, tell us what happened.
It did, the first episode we scheduled actually went out on time, which had never happened.
Then Albert uploaded the rough mix on the same day we recorded, and I had it before lunch.
We still argue about the cold open, but at least now we argue in one place.
After the break, three stories we have already told and one we definitely should not tell again.
Also a reminder that you can find every episode at sozzledpod.com and on Spotify.
